text: I came for teeth whitening, but the dentist recommended scaling, even though I told her I'd just had scaling done three months ago. After the scaling, the dentist said my teeth were already white and didn't need whitening because they were already at a certain level of white on the chart. Why didn't she consult me ​​or tell me this from the beginning? I wasted money on scaling and I'm very disappointed. The dentist isn't skilled at all.
The doctor was very kind and gave excellent advice.
